node.title: detecting an undefined variable
node.author: LloydRice
node.doctext: How do I detect whether a variable has been defined in an enclosing context? I tried my $myscale = 1; if ( defined $scale ) { $myscale = $scale; } When $scale does not exist in the outer context, this fails. So then I tried my $myscale = $scale // 1; with the same result. But "defined" seems to want an existing object (function, array, etc.), So finally, I tried it this way .. my $myscale = extscale // 1; sub extscale { return $scale; } I have reread the Camel sections on "defined" and "exists". Neither of these does what I am looking for. Is there some way to do this?
